name: ECTRIMS Global 2027
organizer: European Committee for Treatment and Research in Multiple Sclerosis (ECTRIMS)
description: ECTRIMS holds ECTRIMS Global 2027 in Vienna, Austria, from 5 to 8 October 2027, including a pre day, the main annual congress, and a patient community day. The event focuses on multiple sclerosis research and treatment.
